notes: better-stack platform; collected by paging https://status.cudocompute.com/incidents/<quarter> for 2026-01/03, 2026-04/06, 2026-07/09 and fetching every /incident/<id> detail page (hand-parsed; collect_status.py has no Better Stack mode)
quarter-page incident counts summed to 0; 0 distinct incident pages fetched

impact_label is the worst per-update affected-service state colour shown by Better Stack (red=Downtime, yellow=Degraded performance, blue=Maintenance, green=none/resolved). Better Stack has no separate impact field; Downtime is mapped to critical, Degraded performance to minor, and incidents with no affected component recorded to none. This mapping was declared in plan-R2 before any analysis.
coverage_start is the first day of the oldest quarter page fetched (that page listed Jan-Mar 2026 month sections); older quarters were not fetched.
